#!/bin/sh
set -eu
root=$1
export JEFE_SOCKET_DIR="$root/sockets"
socket_for() {
  output=$("$1" doctor --config "$root/config" 2>&1 || true)
  while IFS= read -r line; do
    case "$line" in
      *"private socket isolation at "*)
        rest=${line#*private socket isolation at }
        printf '%s\n' "${rest%%;*}"
        return 0
        ;;
    esac
  done <<EOF
$output
EOF
  return 1
}
binary=$(command -v jefe)
socket=$(socket_for "$binary")
test -n "$socket"
cleanup() { tmux -f /dev/null -S "$socket" kill-server >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; }
trap cleanup EXIT INT TERM
tmux -f /dev/null -S "$socket" new-session -d -s issue687-continuity 'sleep 60'
cp "$binary" "$root/jefe-rebuilt"
chmod 755 "$root/jefe-rebuilt"
restarted_socket=$(socket_for "$root/jefe-rebuilt")
test "$socket" = "$restarted_socket"
tmux -f /dev/null -S "$restarted_socket" has-session -t issue687-continuity
printf 'SAME CONFIG RE-ADOPTED SESSION\n'
